Package org.uma.evolver.meta.encoding.solution

Class DerivationTreeSolution

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.meta.encoding.solution.DerivationTreeSolution
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<TreeNode>
public class DerivationTreeSolution extends Object implements org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<TreeNode>
A solution represented as a derivation tree for algorithm configuration.

Each solution encodes a complete algorithm configuration as a tree whose structure mirrors the hierarchical parameter space (grammar). Only active parameters are present in the tree, eliminating the inactive variable problem of flat encodings.

This class implements jMetal's Solution interface, making it compatible with any evolutionary algorithm in the framework. The variables() method returns the tree's root nodes.

Author:
Antonio J. Nebro

      public String[] toParameterArray()
      Converts the derivation tree to a parameter string array suitable for the base-level algorithm's parse() method.

      Only active nodes (those present in the tree) are included in the output.

      array of strings in the format ["--param1", "value1", "--param2", "value2", ...]
